headline: Waaree Energies Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Amalgamation of Indosolar Limited with Waaree Energies Limited and their respective shareholders pursuant to Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act,…
detail: Amalgamation/Merger - Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Amalgamation of Indosolar Limited with Waaree Energies Limited and their respective shareholders pursuant to Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.
